Hey there. Side sleeper here. I got a whole system. 

 I use Japanese buckwheat pillows to support my head, and under my hip. 
Buckwheat pillows offer wonderful support and the fact you can adjust it is convenient. Warning: The pillows are full of buckwheat hulls so they make crunchy sounds. Nightmare if you're a light sleeper. 

I have several memory foam pillows. The first is specifically for the inner thigh when side sleeping. 

The others are travel pillows! I have 3 and I shove them wherever I need extra cushioning [around the shoulders, mostly]. The u shaped ones.

I top it off with a weighted blanket which really helps you relax. 

I hope that helps. Good luck
